blocks.html: We build retail operations apps — checklists, training, issue tracking and analytics — that make every branch run like your best branch. Our retail chain platform is live on the App Store and Google Play.
Customisable open, close and audit checklists with photo proof and timestamps per store.
Bite-sized LMS modules staff actually finish, with scores head office can see.
Structured logging that turns floor problems into trackable, assignable items.
One dashboard for compliance, training and issues across every location.
Role-based access for HQ, area managers and store staff.
Fast on mid-range Android devices and tolerant of patchy store Wi-Fi.
A retail chain management platform unifying four modules — operational checklists, a gamified LMS, issue logs and customer logs — live on the App Store and Google Play.
Checklists, LMS, issue logs and customer logs in one platform
Standardised operations with real-time head-office visibility
Gamified bite-sized training measurably sped up staff onboarding

Idea to app store,
without the drama.
30 minutes on your goals, users and constraints — with an honest read on feasibility.
Scope, timeline and a fixed price within 48 hours. No vague day-rates.
Weekly demo builds you can hold in your hand from the first sprint.
Store submission handled, then monitoring and iteration after launch.
